nodes.description:
Proposed test design based on the supplied requirement. Page behaviour and initial state require review; no browser execution is claimed.
## Preconditions
- Open the application and navigate to the Skills section.
- Ensure Selenium and Playwright are initially unchecked.

## Test steps
1. Select Selenium.
   Expected: Selenium is checked and Playwright remains unchecked.
2. Select Playwright while Selenium is still selected.
   Expected: Both Playwright and Selenium are checked; selecting Playwright does not clear Selenium.
3. Deselect Selenium.
   Expected: Selenium is unchecked and Playwright remains checked.
4. Deselect Playwright.
   Expected: Both Selenium and Playwright are unchecked.

## Acceptance criteria
- Selecting Playwright preserves an existing Selenium selection.
- Deselecting Selenium preserves an existing Playwright selection.

Test design only. Execution and automation completion are not claimed.
